messages:
Maria (CS): Quick heads-up — we need a concise, segmented customer notice for tenants impacted by this morning's onboarding processing disruption. Draft below, please review.
Jordan (Eng): Root cause: external webhook 5xx + retry loop led to duplicate enqueueing in the ingestion queue. Fix deployed at 17:13 UTC (rollback of retry logic and dedupe guard). We're running a controlled backfill.
Priya (Legal): Quick note — avoid language like 'we introduced a bug' or 'we broke'. Use 'we experienced a service disruption' and be careful about definitive compensation promises.
Sam (Support): For high-touch renewals/trials recommend a goodwill gesture. Can CS approve a standard credit amount? Need affected tenant list to prioritize outreach.
Olivia (PM): Suggest offering two short live-help sessions (one APAC-friendly, one EMEA/US-friendly) and a one-pager Q&A.
Maria (CS): Initial draft message (aim for plain, non-technical):
```
Hi <CustomerName>,

We wanted to let you know we experienced a disruption affecting onboarding tasks for a subset of customers between 16:45 and 17:15 UTC. The issue caused some onboarding jobs to be delayed or duplicated. Our engineering team has applied a fix and is running a controlled remediation to bring all affected jobs up to date.

What we’re doing:
- Fixed the underlying processing flow and added dedupe protection.
- Running an automated catch-up for impacted jobs (most tenants should be fully recovered within 3–5 hours).
- Offering a one-time account credit for impacted customers — your CS contact will follow up if you’re eligible.

If you have questions or want a live walkthrough, join our office hours: 15:00 UTC and 23:00 UTC (details below). We’re sorry for the disruption and are here to help.

— The Redwood Inference Team
```
Jordan (Eng): Status update: remediation scripts started at 17:20 UTC. Backfill rate limited to avoid secondary spikes. Most tenants will finish in ~3 hours; a very small subset (~5%) may need manual follow-up.
Priya (Legal): Approved with tone tweak — change 'we caused' -> 'we experienced'. Also remove 'are offering' to 'we will apply' for credits, and avoid exact credit amounts in the public notice.
Maria (CS): Updated wording applied in draft above. @InfraBot can you export the affected tenant IDs so Support can prioritize?
InfraBot: export-run triggered for dataset: impacted_onboards_178999_A. Estimated time: 12 minutes. Job ID: EB-178999-A.
Sam (Support): Got it — I'll start a priority queue for tenants in renewal windows once the export completes. For credit decisions: propose standard tiering (trial = $50; SMB = $200; Enterprise = escalate to PM). Need CS approval to proceed.
Olivia (PM): I approve the tiering for initial outreach; escalate any enterprise exceptions to me. I'll also publish a short FAQ and the office-hours link.
Maria (CS): Ready to send initial tranche at 18:30 UTC to impacted segment 1 (small orgs). Plan: send email -> post to status.redwood.ai -> open office hours at 15:00/23:00 UTC tomorrow. Sam will follow with personalized notes for renewals.
Sam (Support): Subject suggestion: "Redwood notice: onboarding processing update" — will draft follow-ups.
Maria (CS): Final copy below (ready to send):
```
Hello <CustomerName>,

We experienced a service disruption that affected onboarding processing for a subset of customers between 16:45 and 17:15 UTC today. As a result, some onboarding steps were delayed or processed more than once.

What we did:
- Deployed a fix to the processing flow and added deduplication safeguards.
- Launched an automated remediation to catch up affected jobs; most customers should be fully recovered within 3–5 hours.
- Where appropriate, we will apply a one-time account credit and your CS contact will reach out with details.

If you want a live walkthrough or have immediate concerns, join our office hours (link) or reply to this message and we’ll prioritize you.

We’re sorry for the disruption and appreciate your patience.

— Maria, Customer Success on behalf of the Redwood Inference team
```
Olivia (PM): :thumbsup: Looks good. I’ll schedule the office hours and post the status page update after the first emails go out.
Maria (CS): Thanks everyone — will send at 18:30 UTC and update thread once posted. Please DM me if you need early access to the affected list.
Jordan (Eng): Noted — I'll post an engineering follow-up with timelines and the RCA draft once we have the full telemetry.
Maria (CS): Posting complete at 18:31 UTC. First tranche sent to 72 tenants. InfraBot export completed, job EB-178999-A. Next: Sam to start renewals outreach.
Sam (Support): Starting outreach now. Will post a short sync in #support when first 10 customers are contacted.
InfraBot: export-run completed. Files saved to s3://redwood-exports/EB-178999-A.zip
Maria (CS): Closing the thread for planning — will reopen for the formal RCA review once engineering produces the doc. Thanks all. :pray:
